legal.privacy.meta.description.defaultMessage: What TodayZ collects, why, who sees it, and how to use your rights under India's data protection law.

legal.privacy.s1.body.defaultMessage: From shoppers: mobile number, an optional name, the addresses you save, your bookings, and coarse search areas (a neighbourhood-sized area, never an exact location) when you search. From shops: business and store details, contact person and mobile number, the stock and sales data you add, and the payout and identity details needed to verify the business (bank or UPI details, PAN, GSTIN), which are stored encrypted and shown masked. If a shop uses voice to update stock, the recording is sent to speech-to-text and AI services to turn it into a draft the shop confirms. The anti-bot check on our forms (Cloudflare Turnstile) reads signals from your browser and device.

legal.privacy.s2.body.defaultMessage: To run TodayZ: to show shops near you, to handle bookings, to give support and to keep the service safe. We ask for your consent where the law needs it.

legal.privacy.s3.body.defaultMessage: A shop sees the name and a masked mobile number of a shopper who books with it, and the full number only while that order is out for delivery. Services that host TodayZ, send messages, check forms for bots, and turn speech into text handle data on our behalf. Demand insights show shops grouped, anonymous search counts, never a shopper's name or number.

legal.privacy.s4.body.defaultMessage: You can ask to see or correct your data, and you can withdraw your consent, by writing to the grievance officer below. Shoppers can delete their account themselves in the app, once no order is still in progress. Deleting it ends any unused credits, and order and credit records are kept in anonymised form. Shops can ask support to delete their business.

legal.privacy.s5.body.defaultMessage: If the grievance officer does not resolve your complaint, you can complain to the Data Protection Board of India.

legal.terms_shoppers.meta.description.defaultMessage: The rules for using TodayZ to find and book items from shops.

legal.terms_shoppers.s1.body.defaultMessage: TodayZ helps you find items in shops near you and book them. Use it only for yourself, with true details, and do not misuse it.

legal.terms_shoppers.s2.body.defaultMessage: Stock and prices come from the shops and can change. A booking is between you and the shop; TodayZ connects the two of you.

legal.terms_shoppers.s3.body.defaultMessage: Read the refunds and credits page for what happens when a booking is cancelled.

legal.terms_shoppers.s4.body.defaultMessage: We may update these terms and will tell you about important changes before they apply. Indian law applies.

legal.terms_shops.meta.description.defaultMessage: The rules for shops that list stock and take bookings on TodayZ.

legal.terms_shops.s1.body.defaultMessage: You can list the stock you really have and take bookings from people nearby. Keep your details and stock correct.

legal.terms_shops.s2.body.defaultMessage: You are responsible for the goods you sell and for the licences and taxes your shop needs. Do not list goods that the law does not allow you to sell.

legal.terms_shops.s3.body.defaultMessage: Look after the bookings you accept. A booking is between you and the shopper; TodayZ connects the two of you.

legal.terms_shops.s4.body.defaultMessage: TodayZ is free for shops for now. The pricing page always shows the current position.

legal.terms_shops.s5.body.defaultMessage: We may update these terms and will tell you about important changes before they apply. We may pause a shop that breaks them. Indian law applies.

legal.refunds.meta.description.defaultMessage: What happens to a booking when it is cancelled, and how credits work.

legal.refunds.s1.body.defaultMessage: You can cancel a booking any time until it is collected or out for delivery. You pay the shop directly at pickup or delivery; TodayZ does not take payments.

legal.refunds.s2.body.defaultMessage: Credits are not cash and cannot be withdrawn. Each batch of credits has its own expiry date, and the oldest credits are used first. An order can use credits only up to a limit and only above a minimum order value, and credits never pay the delivery fee. Unused credits end when you delete your account.

legal.refunds.s3.body.defaultMessage: If something went wrong with a booking, write to the grievance officer below.
